## Audit summary (illustrative example)

Baseline: 4,000 kWh of electricity and 7,200 kWh of gas a year, about $1,612 (range $1,368 to $1,929).

Within the $14,000 budget the plan selects 3 measures for $13,020 upfront, saving about $935 a year (range $800 to $1,056).
